name: Matinee
summary: A finance, payroll and people back office for an independent two-screen cinema
about: An Art Deco back office for a business with ticket sales, a bar and private hire, shown with an independent cinema with two screens. Velvet curtains open on load, a marquee with chasing bulbs shows tonight's film, and every screening opens a live seat map. Bar stock, private hire quotes, payroll with payslips, people, expenses with film hire, and documents sit behind it.
how: Watch the curtains open, then switch the takings chart between 14D, 12W and 12M to see tickets, bar and hire stacked.
Open a screening to see its seat map: click a seat to sell it, again to comp it, and again to refund it.
Add a screening; it warns you if it clashes with another show on the same screen.
Sell or restock bar items and see low-stock warnings; restocks are logged as expenses.
Quote a private hire live as you change the screen and guest count, then confirm it and take the deposit.
Approve the pay run and read the stamped payslips; work out film hire from this week's ticket takings.
